acid-splash.name: Acid Splash

effects.description: Create an acidic burst at a point within 60 feet; creatures in the 5-foot-radius Sphere make a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 Acid damage on a failure, and damage increases to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11, and 4d6 at level 17.

acid-splash.description: You create an acidic bubble at a point within range, where it explodes in a 5-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage.
acid-splash.higherLevels: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

alarm.name: Alarm

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
The ritual needs a bell and silver wire; it is held throughout the casting.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

effects.description: Create an audible alarm on a door, window, or 20-foot Cube within range; when a creature touches or enters the warded area, the ward emits a handbell sound for 10 seconds within 60 feet.

soundEmission.description: Produces the sound of a handbell for 10 seconds.

effects.description: Create a mental alarm on a door, window, or 20-foot Cube within range; when a creature touches or enters the warded area, the caster receives a mental ping within 1 mile that can wake them from sleep.

alarm.description: You set an alarm against intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won't set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is audible or mental: Audible Alarm. The alarm produces the sound of a handbell for 10 seconds within 60 feet of the warded area. Mental Alarm. You are alerted by a mental ping if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you're asleep.

options.label: Audible Alarm
options.summary: The alarm produces the sound of a handbell for 10 seconds within 60 feet of the warded area.

options.label: Mental Alarm
options.summary: You are alerted by a mental ping if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you're asleep.

animal-friendship.name: Animal Friendship

effects.description: One beast-like target within 30 feet must succeed on a Wisdom save or be Charmed for 24 hours; higher slots add one target per slot level.

conditionalEndings.description: The spell ends if the caster or one of the caster's allies deals damage to the target.

socialEffect.notes: The beast is Charmed for the duration unless the caster or an ally damages it.

animal-friendship.description: Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spell ends.
animal-friendship.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.

arcane-lock.name: Arcane Lock

components.materialDescription: gold dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

effects.description: Magically locks the target object so it can't be unlocked by nonmagical means. Designated creatures can open and close it despite the lock, and an optional password spoken within 5 feet unlocks it for 1 minute.

objectAccessChange.notes: Arcane Lock changes a closed access object into a magical lock that blocks nonmagical unlocking while preserving designated creature access and optional password access.

arcane-lock.description: You touch a closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch and magically lock it for the duration. This lock can't be unlocked by any nonmagical means. You and any creatures you designate when you cast the spell can open and close the object despite the lock. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, unlocks it for 1 minute.

blade-ward.name: Blade Ward

attackRollModifier.notes: Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against the caster before the spell ends, the attacker subtracts 1d4 from the attack roll.

effects.description: Self only. For up to 1 minute with concentration, every incoming attack roll against the caster subtracts 1d4 while the spell remains active.

blade-ward.description: Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you before the spell ends, the attacker subtracts 1d4 from the attack roll.

booming-blade.name: Booming Blade

components.materialDescription: a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp

effects.description: On the melee weapon attack hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects and is sheathed in booming energy until the start of the caster's next turn; at character levels 5, 11, and 17 this hit also adds 1d8, 2d8, or 3d8 Thunder damage.

If the sheathed target willingly moves 5 feet or more before the start of the caster's next turn, it takes 1d8 Thunder damage and the spell ends; this movement damage becomes 2d8, 3d8, or 4d8 at character levels 5, 11, and 17.

booming-blade.description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and then becomes sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn. If the target willingly moves 5 feet or more before then, the target takes 1d8 thunder damage, and the spell ends.
booming-blade.higherLevels: This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 thunder damage to the target on a hit, and the damage the target takes for moving increases to 2d8. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level (2d8 and 3d8) and again at 17th level (3d8 and 4d8).

burning-hands.name: Burning Hands

effects.description: Creatures in the 15-foot Cone make a Dexterity save against 3d6 Fire damage, taking half damage on a success; flammable objects in the Cone that are not worn or carried start burning, and damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1st.

createdObjects.name: Ignited Flammable Objects In Cone
createdObjects.notes: Burning Hands starts flammable objects in the Cone burning when they are not worn or carried.

burning-hands.description: A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried start burning .
burning-hands.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

chill-touch.name: Chill Touch

effects.description: On a melee spell hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, with cantrip-tier damage scaling at character levels 5, 11, and 17.
On a melee spell hit, the target gains the No Healing condition and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of the caster's next turn.
On a melee spell hit against an Undead target, that target gains Disadvantage on attacks against the caster until the end of the caster's next turn.

chill-touch.description: Channeling the chill of the grave, make a melee spell attack against a target within reach. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, and it can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.
chill-touch.higherLevels: Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

comprehend-languages.name: Comprehend Languages

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
The ritual needs a pinch of soot and salt; it is held throughout the casting.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

components.materialDescription: a pinch of soot and salt

effects.description: Understand spoken, signed, and written language you touch for the duration; reading roughly one page per minute; does not decode symbols or secret messages.

surfaceInteraction.notes: Written-language understanding requires the caster to touch the surface on which the words are written.

visionLightSound.audibleInput: literal meaning of any language caster hears
visionLightSound.visualSignedInput: literal meaning of any signed language caster sees
visionLightSound.visualWrittenInput: literal meaning of written language caster sees while touching surface
visionLightSound.touchRequirement: written words require touching the writing surface

understands: written language seen while touching surface
communicationDetails.notes: The spell provides literal understanding, not codebreaking.

comprehend-languages.description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any language that you hear or see signed. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text. This spell doesn't decode symbols or secret messages.

create-bonfire.name: Create Bonfire

effects.description: When the spell is cast, each creature in the 5-foot Cube bonfire space makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 Fire damage; damage scales to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, and 4d8 at level 17.

createdObjects.name: Magic Bonfire
createdObjects.notes: Create Bonfire creates a magical bonfire on visible ground, fills a 5-foot Cube for the duration, ignites flammable objects in the area that are not worn or carried, and uses the existing damage rows for cast, entry, and end-turn saves.

effects.description: A creature that ends its turn in the 5-foot Cube bonfire space makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 Fire damage; damage scales to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, and 4d8 at level 17.

The first time on a turn that a creature enters the 5-foot Cube bonfire space, it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 Fire damage; damage scales to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, and 4d8 at level 17.

create-bonfire.description: You create a bonfire on ground that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the magic bonfire fills a 5-foot cube. Any creature in the bonfire's space when you cast the spell must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 fire damage. A creature must also make the saving throw when it moves into the bonfire's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The bonfire ignites flammable objects in its area that aren't being worn or carried.
create-bonfire.higherLevels: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

create-or-destroy-water.name: Create or Destroy Water

components.materialDescription: a mix of water and sand

scaling.customFormula: +10 gallons created or destroyed, or +5-foot Cube size per slot level above 1 (choose when casting).

effects.description: Choose to create clean water (in containers or as rain that can extinguish exposed flames) or destroy contained water/fog within a 30-foot Cube.

createdObjects.name: Created Water
createdObjects.notes: Create Water mode produces up to 10 gallons of clean water in an open container within range, represented as five one-day water provisions for travel inventory.

createdObjects.name: Created Rain Cube
createdObjects.notes: Create Rain mode makes water fall as rain in a 30-foot Cube and extinguishes exposed flames there; the cube edge grows by 5 feet per slot level above 1st.

scaling.customFormula: +10 gallons destroyed, or +5-foot Cube fog size per slot level above 1 (choose when casting).

effects.description: Destroy Water mode removes up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range, or destroys fog in a 30-foot Cube.

controlOptions.name: Destroy Water
controlOptions.effect: destroy_water
controlOptions.details: Remove up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range.

controlOptions.name: Destroy Fog
controlOptions.effect: destroy_fog
controlOptions.details: Remove fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.

createdObjects.name: Destroyed Contained Water
createdObjects.notes: Destroy Water mode removes up to 10 gallons of water from an open container, plus 10 gallons per slot level above 1st.

createdObjects.name: Destroyed Fog Cube
createdObjects.notes: Destroy Fog mode removes fog in a 30-foot Cube, with the cube edge growing by 5 feet per slot level above 1st.

options.label: Create Contained Water
options.summary: Create up to 10 gallons of clean water in an open container within range.
options.notes: Inventory provisioning currently represents contained clean water as five one-day water provisions at 1st level.

options.label: Create Rain
options.summary: Create rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.
options.scaling: +5-foot Cube edge per slot level above 1st
options.notes: The rain mode uses the Rain Cube spatial form already stored under targeting.spatialDetails.

options.label: Destroy Contained Water
options.summary: Destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range.
options.notes: This mode uses the destroy utility effect without creating inventory water.

options.label: Destroy Fog
options.summary: Destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.
options.scaling: +5-foot Cube edge per slot level above 1st
options.notes: The fog mode uses the Fog Clearance Cube spatial form already stored under targeting.spatialDetails.

modeChoice.notes: The caster chooses one of the four create/destroy water submodes when casting; the option points to the relevant utility effect and target form.

aiContext.prompt: Choose one mode: Create Contained Water, Create Rain, Destroy Contained Water, or Destroy Fog. For contained water, choose an open container; for rain or fog, choose the Cube area.

create-or-destroy-water.description: You do one of the following: Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there. Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.
create-or-destroy-water.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.

cure-wounds.name: Cure Wounds

effects.description: One touched creature regains 2d8 hit points, increasing by 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

cure-wounds.description: A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
cure-wounds.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

dancing-lights.name: Dancing Lights

instanceAllocation.notes: The caster creates up to four torch-size lights as separate hovering instances, or combines the four instances into one glowing Medium humanoid-like form. Movement, range-leash, and vanishing behavior remain tracked by the separate movement/sustain findings.

options.label: Separate Lights
options.summary: Create up to four torch-size hovering lights that appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs.
options.notes: Uses the four independent light instances already tracked by targeting.instanceAllocation.

options.label: Humanoid Form
options.summary: Combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike.
options.notes: Uses the same four-light payload but presents the instances as one combined Medium form.

modeChoice.notes: The selected form changes presentation and instance arrangement; the dim-light radius, movement, leash, and vanishing rules are shared.

effects.description: Creates up to four lights that shed dim light in a 10-foot radius.

grantedActions.notes: Move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range.

dancing-lights.description: You create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius. As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.

darkness.name: Darkness

components.materialDescription: bat fur and a piece of coal

placementEligibility.notes: Darkness can originate from a point in range or from an object that is not worn or carried.

effects.description: Magical Darkness fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere from a point within 60 feet for up to 10 minutes with concentration, or fills a 15-foot Emanation from an unattended object. Darkvision cannot see through it, nonmagical light cannot illuminate it, opaque cover blocks an object-origin Darkness, and overlapping Bright Light or Dim Light from a spell of level 2 or lower is dispelled.

darkness.description: For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere . Darkvision can't see through it, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it. Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness. If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

detect-magic.name: Detect Magic

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

effects.description: For up to 10 minutes with concentration, sense magical effects within a 30-foot Sphere around the caster. With a Magic action, the caster can see auras on visible creatures or objects and learn a spell effect's school, but the sense is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or thin lead.

knowledgeEffect.notes: Detect Magic can reveal visible magical auras with a Magic action and teaches the spell school when the magic came from a spell.

visionLightSound.auraTargets: visible creature or object in area that bears magic
visionLightSound.schoolKnowledge: learn spell school if magic was created by a spell
visionLightSound.lightPayload: aura is visible only through spell sense, not emitted illumination

detect-magic.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic. The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

detect-thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts

effects.description: Sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet from creatures that know languages or are telepathic; this does not read the thoughts and is blocked by listed barriers.

knowledgeEffect.notes: The basic scan senses the presence of thinking creatures without reading their thoughts.

communicationDetails.detects: presence of thoughts from creatures that know languages or are telepathic
communicationDetails.noResult: creatures without languages and not telepathic provide no thoughts to sense

effects.description: Action to probe deeper into one creature; on failed Wisdom save learn reasoning, emotions, and foremost thoughts. On success, the spell ends.

conditionalEndings.description: On a successful save, the spell ends.

knowledgeEffect.notes: A deeper probe can reveal reasoning, emotions, and foremost thoughts on a failed Wisdom save.

communicationDetails.targetGate: target must know a language or be telepathic, otherwise caster learns nothing
communicationDetails.surfaceRead: learns what is most on target mind right now
communicationDetails.deeperProbe: failed Wisdom save reveals reasoning, emotions, and looming concern
communicationDetails.targetAwareness: target knows when caster probes deeper

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose Sense Thoughts or Read Thoughts, then choose the detected or visible target for reading; if the caster probes deeper on a later Magic action, prompt the target's Wisdom save and end the spell on success.

detect-thoughts.description: You activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns. Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don't read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present. The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead. Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing. As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target's mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you discern the target's reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful save, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target's mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.

options.label: Sense Thoughts
options.summary: Sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet from creatures that know languages or are telepathic, without reading those thoughts.
options.notes: This option is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood, 1 inch of metal, or a thin sheet of lead.

options.label: Read Thoughts
options.summary: Target a visible or previously sensed creature within 30 feet to learn what is most on its mind, then optionally probe deeper on a later Magic action.
options.notes: The deeper probe uses the same effect packet and can end the spell on a successful Wisdom save.

modeChoice.notes: The spell lets the caster activate either option when cast and again as a Magic action on later turns.

disguise-self.name: Disguise Self

effects.description: Alter your appearance and gear within size limits; physical contact passes through, and an Intelligence (Investigation) check via the Study action can reveal the illusion.

revealRules.notes: A creature can use its Action to inspect your appearance.
Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it.

illusion.notes: The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection.

disguise-self.description: You make yourself-including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person-look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you. The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing. To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

druidcraft.name: Druidcraft

options.label: Weather Sensor
options.summary: Create a Tiny harmless sensory effect that predicts local weather for the next 24 hours and persists for 1 round.

options.label: Bloom
options.summary: Instantly make a flower blossom, seed pod open, or leaf bud bloom.

options.label: Sensory Effect
options.summary: Create a harmless sensory effect that fits in a 5-foot Cube.

options.label: Fire Play
options.summary: Light or snuff out a candle, torch, or campfire.

modeChoice.notes: The caster chooses exactly one listed Druidcraft effect when the spell resolves.

effects.description: Creates minor nature-themed effects, predicts weather, or lights/snuffs small fires.

controlOptions.effect: Create a Tiny harmless sensory effect that predicts local weather for the next 24 hours.
controlOptions.details: The effect can manifest as a golden orb, cloud, falling snowflakes, or similar omen and persists for 1 round.

controlOptions.name: Bloom
controlOptions.effect: Instantly make a flower blossom, seed pod open, or leaf bud bloom.

controlOptions.name: Sensory Effect
controlOptions.effect: Create a harmless sensory effect such as falling leaves, spectral fairies, a breeze, animal sound, or faint odor.

createdObjects.name: Harmless Nature Sensory Effect

createdObjects.name: Small Flame Toggle
createdObjects.notes: Fire Play lights or snuffs a candle, torch, or campfire.

aiContext.prompt: Choose one Druidcraft option before casting: Weather Sensor, Bloom, Sensory Effect, or Fire Play.

druidcraft.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range. Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round. Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom. Sensory Effect. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube. Fire Play. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.

elementalism.name: Elementalism

options.label: Beckon Air
options.summary: Create a breeze in a 5-foot Cube.

options.label: Beckon Earth
options.summary: Cover surfaces in a 5-foot-square area with dust or sand, or write one word in dirt or sand.

options.label: Beckon Fire
options.summary: Create harmless embers and chosen color/scent smoke in a 5-foot Cube, with embers able to light small flames.

options.label: Beckon Water
options.summary: Create cool mist in a 5-foot Cube or create 1 cup of clean water that evaporates in 1 minute.

options.label: Sculpt Element
options.summary: Shape dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water fitting in a 1-foot Cube into a crude shape for 1 hour.

modeChoice.notes: The caster chooses exactly one listed Elementalism effect when the spell resolves.

effects.description: Creates one of five minor elemental effects: Beckon Air, Beckon Earth, Beckon Fire, Beckon Water, or Sculpt Element.

createdObjects.name: Elemental Breeze
createdObjects.notes: Beckon Air creates a harmless breeze in a 5-foot Cube. Doors and shutters held open by someone or something are not affected.

createdObjects.name: Dust Or Sand Shroud
createdObjects.notes: Beckon Earth covers a 5-foot-square surface with dust or sand, or writes one word in dirt or sand in the caster's handwriting.

createdObjects.name: Harmless Embers And Smoke
createdObjects.notes: Beckon Fire creates harmless embers and colored, scented smoke. The embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in the area; the scent lingers for 1 minute.

createdObjects.name: Cool Mist Or Clean Water
createdObjects.notes: Beckon Water creates cool mist in a 5-foot Cube or 1 cup of clean water in an open container or on a surface. The created cup of water evaporates in 1 minute.

createdObjects.name: Crude Elemental Shape
createdObjects.notes: Sculpt Element shapes dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that fits in a 1-foot Cube into a crude form for 1 hour.

controlOptions.name: Beckon Air
controlOptions.effect: Create a breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters.
controlOptions.details: Doors and shutters being held open by someone or something aren't affected.

controlOptions.name: Beckon Earth
controlOptions.effect: Create a thin shroud of dust or sand that covers surfaces in a 5-foot-square area.
controlOptions.details: Alternatively, cause a single word to appear in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand.

controlOptions.name: Beckon Fire
controlOptions.effect: Create a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke in a 5-foot Cube.
controlOptions.details: You choose the color and scent; the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in that area, and the smoke's scent lingers for 1 minute.

controlOptions.name: Beckon Water
controlOptions.effect: Create a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube.
controlOptions.details: Alternatively, create 1 cup of clean water either in an open container or on a surface; the water evaporates in 1 minute.

controlOptions.name: Sculpt Element
controlOptions.effect: Cause dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit in a 1-foot Cube to assume a crude shape.
controlOptions.details: The crude shape can be such as that of a creature and lasts for 1 hour.

createdResource.note: Cantrip creates minor temporary resources without material consumption.

aftermathState.note: Tracks lingering sensory/resource aftermath after the cantrip mode resolves.

aiContext.prompt: Choose one Elementalism option before casting: Beckon Air, Beckon Earth, Beckon Fire, Beckon Water, or Sculpt Element.

elementalism.description: You exert control over the elements, creating one of the following effects within range. Beckon Air. You create a breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters, all in a 5-foot Cube. Doors and shutters being held open by someone or something aren't affected. Beckon Earth. You create a thin shroud of dust or sand that covers surfaces in a 5-foot-square area, or you cause a single word to appear in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand. Beckon Fire. You create a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke in a 5-foot Cube. You choose the color and scent, and the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in that area. The smoke's scent lingers for 1 minute. Beckon Water. You create a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube. Alternatively, you create 1 cup of clean water either in an open container or on a surface, and the water evaporates in 1 minute. Sculpt Element. You cause dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit in a 1-foot Cube to assume a crude shape (such as that of a creature) for 1 hour.

enlarge-reduce.name: Enlarge/Reduce

effects.description: Enlarge increases the target size by one category after any required Constitution save, along with worn and carried gear. The target has Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saves, and its weapon attacks and Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage.

abilityCheckModifier.notes: The Enlarge mode grants Advantage on Strength checks.

savingThrowModifier.notes: The Enlarge mode grants Advantage on Strength saving throws.

attackAugments.notes: While enlarged, the target's enlarged weapons and Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage on a hit.

carriedItemState.itemPropagation: everything the target is wearing and carrying changes size with it
carriedItemState.droppedItemReversion: any item the target drops returns to normal size at once
carriedItemState.thrownWeaponReversion: a thrown weapon or piece of ammunition returns to normal size immediately after it hits or misses a target

effects.description: Reduce decreases the target size by one category after any required Constitution save, along with worn and carried gear. The target has Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saves, and its weapon attacks and Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 less damage, to a minimum of 1.

abilityCheckModifier.notes: The Reduce mode gives Disadvantage on Strength checks.

savingThrowModifier.notes: The Reduce mode gives Disadvantage on Strength saving throws.

attackAugments.notes: While reduced, the target's reduced weapons and Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 less damage on a hit, never reducing damage below 1.

carriedItemState.itemPropagation: everything the target is wearing and carrying changes size with it
carriedItemState.droppedItemReversion: any item the target drops returns to normal size at once
carriedItemState.thrownWeaponReversion: a thrown weapon or piece of ammunition returns to normal size immediately after it hits or misses a target

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose Enlarge or Reduce and the visible creature or loose object target; if the target is an unwilling creature, prompt the Constitution save before applying size, Strength-check/save, and attack-damage changes.

enlarge-reduce.description: For the duration, the spell enlarges or reduces a creature or an object you can see within range (see the chosen effect below). A targeted object must be neither worn nor carried. If the target is an unwilling creature, it can make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the spell has no effect. Everything that a targeted creature is wearing and carrying changes size with it. Any item it drops returns to normal size at once. A thrown weapon or piece of ammunition returns to normal size immediately after it hits or misses a target. Enlarge. The target's size increases by one category-from Medium to Large, for example. The target also has Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target's attacks with its enlarged weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 damage on a hit. Reduce. The target's size decreases by one category-from Medium to Small, for example. The target also has Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target's attacks with its reduced weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 less damage on a hit (this can't reduce the damage below 1).

options.label: Enlarge
options.summary: The target's size increases by one category. Advantage on Str checks/saves. Attacks deal extra 1d4 damage.

options.label: Reduce
options.summary: The target's size decreases by one category. Disadvantage on Str checks/saves. Attacks deal 1d4 less damage.

entangle.name: Entangle

effects.description: Create a 20-foot Square of grasping plants within 90 feet for up to 1 minute with concentration; the area is Difficult Terrain until the spell ends.

Each creature in the 20-foot Square when the plants appear makes a Strength save or gains the Restrained condition for up to 1 minute, with a Strength (Athletics) action to escape and the listed end-turn Wisdom save to end it.

The first time on a turn that a creature enters the 20-foot Square, it makes a Strength save or gains the Restrained condition, with the same Strength (Athletics) escape action and listed end-turn Wisdom save.
A creature that ends its turn in the 20-foot Square makes a Strength save or gains the Restrained condition, with the same Strength (Athletics) escape action and listed end-turn Wisdom save.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to place the 20-foot square within 90 feet; creatures other than the caster in the area make Strength saves, and Restrained creatures can use an action for a Strength (Athletics) escape check against the spell save DC.

entangle.description: Grasping plants sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into Difficult Terrain . They disappear when the spell ends. Each creature (other than you) in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself from the grasping plants and is no longer Restrained by them.

faerie-fire.name: Faerie Fire

effects.description: Outlined creatures shed dim light, cannot benefit from Invisible, and attackers who can see them have Advantage.

attackRollModifier.notes: Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage only if the attacker can see the outlined target.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to place the 20-foot cube and choose blue, green, or violet light; creatures in the cube make Dexterity saves, and attack rolls against outlined visible targets have Advantage.

faerie-fire.description: Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition. Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.

false-life.name: False Life

effects.description: The caster gains 2d4 + 4 temporary hit points, increasing by 5 temporary hit points for each slot level above 1st.

false-life.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You gain 5 additional Temporary Hit Points for each spell slot level above 1.

fire-bolt.name: Fire Bolt

effects.description: One creature or object within 120 feet takes 1d10 Fire damage on a ranged spell hit; a flammable object hit by the spell starts burning if it is not worn or carried, and damage increases to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, and 4d10 at level 17.

createdObjects.name: Ignited Flammable Object
createdObjects.notes: Fire Bolt has a real environmental rider: a flammable object hit by the spell starts burning if it is not worn or carried.

fire-bolt.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.
fire-bolt.higherLevels: This spell's damage increases by 1d10 when you reach 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10), and 17th level (4d10).

flame-blade.name: Flame Blade

effects.description: Melee spell attack with the summoned blade deals Fire damage equal to 3d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
The flaming blade sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

createdObjects.name: Fiery Blade
createdObjects.notes: A scimitar-shaped flame appears in the caster's free hand, disappears if released, and can be re-evoked as a Bonus Action while the spell lasts.

grantedActions.notes: As a Magic action, make a melee spell attack with the fiery blade; on a hit, deal 3d6 Fire damage plus the caster's spellcasting ability modifier.
If the caster lets go of the blade, it disappears; while the spell lasts, the caster can evoke it again as a Bonus Action.

aiContext.prompt: Create the fiery blade in the caster's free hand; on later Magic actions, prompt for the melee spell attack target, and if the caster let go of the blade, offer the Bonus Action to re-evoke it.

flame-blade.description: You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a scimitar, and it lasts for the duration. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke it again as a Bonus Action. As a Magic action, you can make a melee spell attack with the fiery blade. On a hit, the target takes Fire damage equal to 3d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The flaming blade sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
flame-blade.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.

fog-cloud.name: Fog Cloud

scaling.customFormula: Increase radius by 20 feet for each slot level above 1.

effects.description: Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of heavily obscuring fog centered on a point within 120 feet for up to 1 hour with concentration; strong wind disperses the fog, and higher-level slots increase the radius by 20 feet per slot level above 1.

createdObjects.name: Heavily Obscuring Fog Cloud
createdObjects.shelfLife: up to 1 hour with concentration or until strong wind disperses it
createdObjects.notes: Fog Cloud creates a heavily obscured 20-foot-radius fog Sphere; strong wind, including Gust of Wind, disperses it early.

fog-cloud.description: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The Sphere is Heavily Obscured . It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it.
fog-cloud.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The fog's radius increases by 20 feet for each spell slot level above 1.

friends.name: Friends

saveOutcomeOverrides.reason: auto_success when fighting caster or allies.
auto_success when recently affected by spell.

effects.description: One nearby Humanoid that is not fighting the caster or the caster's allies and has not been affected by this casting within the last 24 hours must succeed on a Wisdom save or gain the Charmed condition for 1 minute.

friends.description:
You magically emanate a sense of friendship toward one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you have cast this spell on it within the past 24 hours.

The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or force anyone to make a saving throw. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.

gust-of-wind.name: Gust of Wind

effects.description: Creatures in the 60-foot by 10-foot Line make a Strength save against being pushed 15 feet away from the caster along the Line when the wind affects them.

The Line disperses gas or vapor, extinguishes candles and similar unprotected flames, makes protected flames dance with a 50 percent extinguish chance, and grants the caster a later-turn Bonus Action to change the Line direction.

grantedActions.notes: Change the direction in which the Line blasts from you.

createdObjects.name: Strong Wind Line
createdObjects.notes: Gust of Wind creates a persistent 60-by-10-foot strong-wind Line with gas/vapor dispersal, flame effects, movement pressure, and later-turn direction changes.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose the initial 60-foot line direction; each affected creature makes the Strength save against the 15-foot push, and on later turns prompt for the Bonus Action direction change.

gust-of-wind.description: A Line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the duration. Each creature in the Line must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you in a direction following the Line. A creature that ends its turn in the Line must make the same save. Any creature in the Line must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves when moving closer to you. The gust disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles and similar unprotected flames in the area. It causes protected flames, such as those of lanterns, to dance wildly and has a 50 percent chance to extinguish them. As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can change the direction in which the Line blasts from you.

hellish-rebuke.name: Hellish Rebuke

castingTime.reactionCondition: when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you

combatCost.condition: when a creature you can see within 60 feet damages you

effects.description: When a visible creature within 60 feet damages the caster, that creature makes a Dexterity save against 2d10 Fire damage, taking half damage on a success; damage increases by 1d10 per slot level above 1st.

hellish-rebuke.description: The creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by green flames. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
hellish-rebuke.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

hold-person.name: Hold Person

effects.description: One visible Humanoid within 60 feet that fails the Wisdom save is Paralyzed for up to 1 minute with concentration, repeats the Wisdom save at the end of each turn to end the spell on itself, and higher-level slots add one Humanoid target per slot level above 2.

hold-person.description: Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
hold-person.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional Humanoid for each spell slot level above 2.

hunters-mark.name: Hunter's Mark

effects.description: When the caster hits the marked target with a weapon attack, the spell adds 1d6 Force damage.

The caster has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception or Survival) checks to find the marked target, and if it drops to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends, the caster can use a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new visible creature within range.

abilityCheckModifier.appliesTo: Wisdom (Perception or Survival) checks to find the marked target
abilityCheckModifier.notes: The Advantage applies only to Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) checks made to find the marked target.

conditionalEndings.description: If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.

knowledgeEffect.notes: The caster has Advantage on Perception or Survival checks to find the marked target and can retarget when it drops to 0 HP before the spell ends.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose one visible quarry within 90 feet; when the marked target drops to 0 Hit Points, prompt for the Bonus Action move to a new visible creature within range.

hunters-mark.description: You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. You also have Advantage on any Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check you make to find it. If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.
hunters-mark.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 3-4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours).

invisibility.name: Invisibility

effects.description: Touch one creature for up to 1 hour with concentration; the target gains the Invisible condition until the spell ends early after it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell. Higher slots add one target per slot level above 2.
The touched creature gains the Invisible condition for up to 1 hour with concentration; this spell ends early after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

conditionalEndings.description: The spell ends immediately after the target makes an attack roll.
The spell ends immediately after the target deals damage.
The spell ends immediately after the target casts a spell.

invisibility.description: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
invisibility.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

jump.name: Jump

effects.description: Once on each of the willing target's turns until the spell ends, it can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

jump.description: You touch a willing creature. Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, that creature can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
jump.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

lesser-restoration.name: Lesser Restoration

effects.description: Touch one creature and choose one removable condition on it; Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned ends immediately.

aiContext.prompt: Choose one condition on the touched creature to end immediately: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

lesser-restoration.description: You touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded , Deafened , Paralyzed , or Poisoned .

levitate.name: Levitate

objectEligibility.notes: Levitate can target one visible creature or one loose object within range; an object target must weigh no more than 500 pounds.

effects.description: One creature or loose object rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended; you can adjust altitude by 20 feet on your turn or with a Magic action if moving another target.

surfaceInteraction.notes: A levitated target can move horizontally only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach, and gently descends to the ground when the spell ends.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose one visible creature or loose object within 60 feet; unwilling creatures make a Constitution save before levitation, then prompt altitude changes up to 20 feet when the caster moves self or uses the Magic action for another target.

levitate.description: One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate an object that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution saving throw is unaffected. The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can take a Magic action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range. When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.

light.name: Light

effects.description: Object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

conditionalEndings.description: The light spell ends if the caster casts it again.

light.description: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

locate-object.name: Locate Object

effects.description: Sense direction to a familiar or specific-kind object within 1,000 feet unless blocked by lead; learn movement direction if it moves.

knowledgeEffect.notes: Locate Object reports direction, and movement direction if moving, for a known specific object seen up close or nearest object of a kind within 1,000 feet unless lead blocks it.

locate-object.description: Describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location if that object is within 1,000 feet of you. If the object is in motion, you know the direction of its movement. The spell can locate a specific object known to you if you have seen it up close-within 30 feet-at least once. Alternatively, the spell can locate the nearest object of a particular kind, such as a certain kind of apparel, jewelry, furniture, tool, or weapon. This spell can't locate an object if any thickness of lead blocks a direct path between you and the object.

longstrider.name: Longstrider

effects.description: Touch one creature for 1 hour; the target gains +10 feet to Speed, and higher slots let the caster target one additional creature per slot level above 1.

longstrider.description: You touch a creature. The target's Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.
longstrider.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

mage-armor.name: Mage Armor

effects.description: Sets base AC to 13 + Dex modifier while unarmored.

conditionalEndings.description: The spell ends early if the affected target puts on armor.

mage-armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

mage-hand.name: Mage Hand

effects.description: Creates a spectral hand to manipulate objects. Control as an Action.

controlledEntity.notes: The hand appears at a point within range, can be used when the spell is cast, can be controlled again on later turns as a Magic action, and can move up to 30 feet as part of that action.

conditionalEndings.description: The hand vanishes if the caster casts Mage Hand again.
The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from the caster.

mage-hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

magic-mouth.name: Magic Mouth

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
The ritual needs jade dust worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes; the casting consumes it.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

components.materialDescription: jade dust worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes

effects.description: Stores a spoken message and a trigger condition; when triggered, the mouth appears and speaks the message, then the spell ends.

visionLightSound.targetRequirement: object caster can see that is not worn or carried
visionLightSound.voice: caster voice at same volume caster spoke
visionLightSound.visual: magical mouth appears on object or existing mouth-like feature
visionLightSound.triggerBasis: visual or audible conditions within 30 feet of object
visionLightSound.repeatMode: can end after one delivery or remain and repeat

communicationDetails.voice: recites in caster voice and at the same volume spoken during casting
communicationDetails.mouthPlacement: appears on chosen object, using an existing mouth-like feature if present
communicationDetails.spellEnd: spell ends after message is delivered

magic-mouth.description: You implant a message within an object in range-a message that is uttered when a trigger condition is met. Choose an object that you can see and that isn't being worn or carried by another creature. Then speak the message, which must be 25 words or fewer, though it can be delivered over as long as 10 minutes. Finally, determine the circumstance that will trigger the spell to deliver your message. When that trigger occurs, a magical mouth appears on the object and recites the message in your voice and at the same volume you spoke. If the object you chose has a mouth or something that looks like a mouth (for example, the mouth of a statue), the magical mouth appears there, so the words appear to come from the object's mouth. When you cast this spell, you can have the spell end after it delivers its message, or it can remain and repeat its message whenever the trigger occurs. The trigger can be as general or as detailed as you like, though it must be based on visual or audible conditions that occur within 30 feet of the object. For example, you could instruct the mouth to speak when any creature moves within 30 feet of the object or when a silver bell rings within 30 feet of it.

magic-weapon.name: Magic Weapon

objectEligibility.notes: Magic Weapon targets a touched nonmagical weapon, not a generic object.

effects.description: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. If the weapon isn't magical, it counts as a magic weapon for the duration.

attackRollModifier.notes: The touched weapon gains a +1 attack-roll bonus at level 2, +2 with slots 3-5, and +3 with slots 6+.

damageRollModifier.notes: The touched weapon gains the same flat bonus to damage rolls.

scaling.customFormula: Weapon attack and damage bonus is +1 at a 2nd-level slot, +2 with a 3rd-5th-level slot, and +3 with a 6th-level or higher slot.

conditionalEndings.description: The magic weapon spell ends early if the caster casts it again.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose the touched nonmagical weapon; apply the slot-scaled magic weapon bonus to attack and damage rolls, and end the prior casting if Magic Weapon is cast again.

magic-weapon.description: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. The spell ends early if you cast it again.
magic-weapon.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The bonus increases to +2 with a level 3-5 spell slot. The bonus increases to +3 with a level 6+ spell slot.

mending.name: Mending

effects.description: Repairs a single break or tear in an object no larger than 1 foot in any dimension.

repairState.notes: Mending physically repairs one break or tear no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, including physical damage on a magic item, but never restores lost magic.

mending.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage. This spell can physically repair a magic item, but it can't restore magic to such an object.

message.name: Message

effects.description: Sends a whispered message to a creature within range. The target can reply in a whisper only you can hear.

communicationDetails.notes: Message can pass through solid objects only when the caster is familiar with the target and knows it is beyond the barrier.

visionLightSound.reply: target can reply in whisper only caster hears
visionLightSound.solidObjectPass: allowed only when caster is familiar with target and knows target is beyond barrier

message.description: You point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear. You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.

minor-illusion.name: Minor Illusion

options.label: Sound
options.summary: Create a sound whose volume can range from a whisper to a scream and that can continue unabated or occur discretely at different times.
options.notes: Sound-mode volume, timing, and reveal details are represented by sensoryManifestation and illusion metadata.

options.label: Image
options.summary: Create an image of an object no larger than a 5-foot Cube.
options.notes: Image-mode sensory exclusions, physical interaction reveal, and faint-on-discern behavior are represented by sensoryManifestation and illusion metadata.

modeChoice.notes: This captures the two canonical creation modes; detailed sensory restrictions, reveal rules, and recast ending are represented by sensoryManifestation, illusion, and conditionalEndings metadata.

effects.description: Create a sound or an image of an object (max 5ft cube) that lasts for the duration. Intelligence (Investigation) check vs Spell Save DC reveals it as illusion.

variants.label: Sound
variants.notes: The caster chooses the sound, from a whisper to a scream, and can keep it unabated or make discrete sounds before the spell ends.

variants.label: Image
variants.notes: The image is an object image only; it cannot create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect.

sensoryManifestation.notes: These variants refine the top-level modeChoice menu rather than adding extra spell modes.

revealRules.notes: A creature that takes the Study action can identify either mode as an illusion on a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check.
Physical interaction reveals image mode because things pass through it.

illusion.notes: Discerning the illusion changes that creature's perception; it does not end the spell for everyone.

conditionalEndings.description: The illusion ends if the caster casts Minor Illusion again.

minor-illusion.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again. If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature. Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. Image. If you create an image of an object-such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest-it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

misty-step.name: Misty Step

effects.description: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

misty-step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

nondetection.name: Nondetection

components.materialDescription: a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

objectEligibility.notes: Nondetection can protect an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension.

placeEligibility.notes: Nondetection can protect a touched place no larger than 10 feet in any dimension.

targetTypeEligibility.notes: Creature targets must be willing; place and object targets are constrained by the 10-foot maximum dimension.

effects.description: Protects the touched willing creature, place, or up-to-10-foot object from Divination targeting and magical scrying sensors for 8 hours.

nondetection.description: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from Divination spells. The target can be a willing creature, or it can be a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can't be targeted by any Divination spell or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

pass-without-trace.name: Pass without Trace

effects.description: You radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation; creatures in the aura have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.

abilityCheckModifier.notes: The caster and chosen creatures in the 30-foot Emanation gain +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.

traceState.notes: Pass without Trace explicitly suppresses track creation for chosen creatures while they remain in the 30-foot concealing aura.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster which creatures in the 30-foot Emanation are included; included creatures gain +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks while in the aura and leave no tracks.

pass-without-trace.description: You radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.

poison-spray.name: Poison Spray

scaling.customFormula: 1d12 at level 1, 2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at level 11, 4d12 at level 17

effects.description: One creature within 30 feet takes 1d12 Poison damage on a ranged spell hit; damage increases to 2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at level 11, and 4d12 at level 17.

poison-spray.description: You spray toxic mist at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 Poison damage.
poison-spray.higherLevels: This spell's damage increases by 1d12 when you reach 5th level (2d12), 11th level (3d12), and 17th level (4d12).

prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation

If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. produce-flame.name: Produce Flame

effects.description: The held flame sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet, emits no heat, ignites nothing, and ends if the caster casts this spell again.

conditionalEndings.description: The held flame spell ends if the caster casts it again.

scaling.customFormula: 1d8 at level 1, 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, 4d8 at level 17

effects.description: Until the spell ends, the caster can take a Magic action to hurl the flame at one creature or object within 60 feet; on a ranged spell hit, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage, and damage increases to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, and 4d8 at level 17.

grantedActions.notes: Until the spell ends, the caster can take a Magic action to hurl the flame at one creature or object within 60 feet.

produce-flame.description: A flickering flame appears in your hand and remains there for the duration. While there, the flame emits no heat and ignites nothing, and it sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The spell ends if you cast it again. Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to hurl fire at a creature or an object within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage.
produce-flame.higherLevels: This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

ray-of-enfeeblement.name: Ray of Enfeeblement

effects.description: On a failed Constitution save, the target becomes Enfeebled for up to 1 minute: it has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests, subtracts 1d8 from damage rolls, and repeats the Constitution save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success. On a successful initial save, it only has Disadvantage on its next attack roll until the start of your next turn.

attackRollModifier.notes: If the target succeeds on the initial Constitution save, it has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes until the start of the caster's next turn.

abilityCheckModifier.notes: On a failed Constitution save, the target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests for the spell duration.

damageRollModifier.notes: On a failed Constitution save, the target subtracts 1d8 from all damage rolls until the spell ends.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to choose one creature within 60 feet; prompt the Constitution save, apply next-attack Disadvantage on success, or Enfeebled Strength-test Disadvantage and -1d8 damage rolls on failure with end-turn repeat saves.

ray-of-enfeeblement.description: A beam of enervating energy shoots from you toward a creature within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes until the start of your next turn. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests for the duration. During that time, it also subtracts 1d8 from all its damage rolls. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

ray-of-sickness.name: Ray of Sickness

effects.description: On a ranged spell hit, one target takes 2d8 Poison damage, increasing by 1d8 per slot level above 1st.
On the triggering ranged spell attack hit, the target gains the Poisoned condition until the end of the caster's next turn.

aiContext.prompt: Resolve the ranged spell attack. On a hit, apply 2d8 Poison damage plus slot scaling and mark the target Poisoned until the end of the caster's next turn.

ray-of-sickness.description: You shoot a greenish ray at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.
ray-of-sickness.higherLevels: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

sacred-flame.name: Sacred Flame

saveModifiers.reason: Target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this save.

effects.description: One visible creature within 60 feet makes a Dexterity save that gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover; on a failure it takes 1d8 Radiant damage, and damage increases to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11, and 4d8 at level 17.

sacred-flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this save.
sacred-flame.higherLevels: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

shield.description: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile .

shocking-grasp.name: Shocking Grasp

effects.description: On a melee spell hit, one target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, with cantrip-tier damage scaling at character levels 5, 11, and 17.
On the triggering melee spell hit, the target has opportunity attacks suppressed for 1 round.

shocking-grasp.description: Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target, with Advantage if the target is wearing metal armor. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

areaTargetSelection.notes: The caster chooses which creatures in the 5-foot-radius Sphere are affected; unchosen creatures in the area are not affected.

saveOutcomeOverrides.reason: Creatures that do not sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to Exhaustion automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

effects.description: If a creature Incapacitated by this spell fails the repeat Wisdom save at the end of its next turn, it becomes Unconscious for the spell's duration.

aiContext.prompt: Ask the caster to place the 5-foot-radius sphere and choose which creatures in it are affected; skip targets that do not sleep or have Exhaustion immunity because they automatically succeed, then prompt the initial and repeat Wisdom saves.

sleep.description: Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the Unconscious condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect. Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

Most Beasts have little to say about topics that don't pertain to survival or companionship, but at minimum, a Beast can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever it has perceived within the past day.

spike-growth.name: Spike Growth

spike-growth.description: The ground in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes Difficult Terrain for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels. The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area when the spell is cast must take a Search action and succeed on a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

suggestion.name: Suggestion

effects.description: One creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand the caster makes a Wisdom save; on a failure, it follows a reasonable suggestion for up to 8 hours with concentration, ending early if the caster or allies damage it or when the suggested activity is completed.

conditionalEndings.description: The spell ends for the target if the caster or the caster's allies deal damage to that target.
If the suggested activity can be completed before the full duration, the spell ends for the target when that activity is completed.

socialEffect.notes: Suggestion requires an achievable non-obviously-harmful course of action, a target that hears and understands, and ends if the caster or allies damage it.

communicationDetails.notes: The control effect is delivered as a short course of activity the target can hear and understand.

effects.description: A failed Wisdom save applies the Charmed condition for the spell's duration or until the spell ends early.

conditionalEndings.description: Damage dealt to the target by the caster or the caster's allies ends the spell for that target.
Completing the suggested activity before the full duration ends the spell for that target.

socialEffect.duration: up to 8 hours concentration or until early ending
socialEffect.notes: The failed-save target has Charmed while following the suggestion.

communicationDetails.notes: The control effect is delivered as a short course of activity the target can hear and understand.

aiContext.prompt: The player is casting Suggestion. Adjudicate the requested command. The suggestion must sound reasonable, be achievable within 8 hours, and not involve anything that would obviously deal damage to the target or its allies. For example, 'drop your weapons and flee' is okay, 'stab yourself' is not. Evaluate if the command meets these criteria. If valid, approve it and optionally define narrative mechanical effects. If invalid, reject it.

suggestion.description: You suggest a course of activity-described in no more than 25 words-to one creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must sound achievable and not involve anything that would obviously deal damage to the target or its allies. For example, you could say, "Fetch the key to the cult's treasure vault, and give the key to me." Or you could say, "Stop fighting, leave this library peacefully, and don't return." The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target. The Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for the target upon completing it.

water-walk.name: Water Walk

requirements.description: The ritual must be chanted aloud from start to finish.
The ritual needs a free hand for its gestures throughout.
The ritual needs a piece of cork; it is held throughout the casting.
Ritual casting adds 10 minutes to the casting time and must run uninterrupted.

effects.description: Choose up to ten creatures within 30 feet for 1 hour. Targets can move across liquid surfaces as harmless solid ground and can use a Bonus Action to pass between a liquid's surface and the liquid itself, while falling into the liquid bypasses that Bonus Action requirement.

grantedActions.action: Pass between the liquid's surface and the liquid itself, or vice versa.
grantedActions.notes: Falling into the liquid bypasses this Bonus Action requirement and passes the target through the surface into the liquid below.

liquidSurfaceMovement.notes: Water Walk changes how chosen creatures interact with liquid surfaces without making those liquids harmless for all purposes; lava heat damage still applies.

surfaceInteraction.notes: Targets can move across liquid surfaces as harmless solid ground, but lava heat can still harm them and moving between the surface and liquid requires the spell-specific movement rule.

water-walk.description: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface-such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava-as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat). Up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range gain this ability for the duration. An affected target must take a Bonus Action to pass from the liquid's surface into the liquid itself and vice versa, but if the target falls into the liquid, the target passes through the surface into the liquid below.
